items.exampleEn: The teacher demonstrated how to use the new machine.
items.exampleZh: 老師示範新機器的使用方法。

items.exampleEn: Are you aware of the new rules?
The manager accepted my proposal for a new website.
items.exampleZh: 經理接受了我做新網站的提案。

items.exampleEn: She acknowledged that she had made a mistake.
The scientists came to a clear conclusion.
items.exampleZh: 科學家們得出了一個明確的結論。

items.exampleEn: The report concludes that we need more staff.
items.exampleZh: 報告的結論是我們需要更多人手。

items.exampleEn: Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby?
items.exampleZh: 你可以推薦附近一家好餐廳嗎？

items.sentenceEn: We are aware that the train is late today.
items.sentenceZh: 我們知道今天火車誤點了。

items.audioEn: Please read my proposal and send me your comments by Friday.
items.audioZh: 請看一下我的提案，星期五前把意見寄給我。
items.questionZh: 說話者希望對方星期五前做什麼？
options: Say what they think of the plan.
Write a new proposal for Friday.
Send the proposal to the manager.

items.sentenceEn: The meeting concluded with a short speech from the boss.
items.sentenceZh: 會議以老闆簡短的致詞作結。

items.sentenceEn: Please acknowledge that you have received this email.
items.sentenceZh: 收到這封郵件後請回覆告知。

items.stemEn: The waiter ____ the fish, so we ordered it.
items.stemZh: 服務生推薦那道魚，所以我們點了。

items.stemEn: The boy ____ eating the cake, but there was cream on his face.
items.stemZh: 男孩否認吃了蛋糕，但他臉上沾著奶油。

items.passageEn: Last month, Helen made a proposal to her boss: the office should use less paper. To demonstrate the problem, she showed that the office used approximately two thousand sheets of paper a week. Her boss acknowledged the problem, but at first he was not aware of how much it cost. After reading her report, he concluded that she was right. Nobody could deny the numbers. The conclusion was simple: from next month, all reports will be online. The boss also recommended Helen for a pay rise.
items.passageZh: 上個月，Helen 向老闆提了一個建議：辦公室應該少用紙。為了說明問題，她指出辦公室每週大約用掉兩千張紙。老闆承認有這個問題，但一開始並不知道要花多少錢。看完她的報告後，他認定她是對的。沒有人能否認這些數字。結論很簡單：從下個月起，所有報告都放在網路上。老闆還推薦 Helen 加薪。

questions.questionZh: 老闆最後做了什麼決定？
options: 下月起報告都放網路上
改買比較便宜的影印紙

referenceEn: I recommend this book to you.
I would recommend this book to you.
rubricZh: recommend 表示「推薦」，可用 recommend A to B（例如 recommend this book to you）
寫 I recommend that you read this book. 也正確
主詞是 I，現在式用 recommend

items.instructionZh: 用 aware 造一個句子，說說一件你最近才知道或意識到的事。
referenceEn: I was not aware that the shop closed early on Sundays.
I became aware of the problem only last week.
rubricZh: aware 例如 be aware of＋名詞、be aware that＋子句等說法
時態配合內容（例如 was not aware、became aware）
